intro.heading: The matchup
intro.body:
One game left, and this one is about the finish. **Klein Cain (5-4, 3-4)** closes the regular season at **Klein Forest (1-8, 1-6)** on Friday, November 6 at 7:00 PM at Klein Memorial Stadium. Thursday's loss to Magnolia ended Cain's playoff chase, so the finale carries a simpler stake: beat the Golden Eagles, finish **6-4**, and send the seniors out with a winning season.

The math closed Thursday night. Cain sits **sixth** in **District 15-6A**, and only the **top four** advance to the playoffs. Magnolia (5-2) moved alone into **second** behind Klein (6-1), and both are beyond Cain's best possible district finish of **4-4**. Klein Oak, Tomball and Klein Collins are all tied at **4-2**, and Klein Oak and Klein Collins play each other in the finale, which guarantees one of them a fifth district win. The one tie at 4-4 that could still form, Cain alongside Tomball and Klein Collins, breaks against the Hurricanes on the district points tiebreaker: Tomball's **36-14** win over Collins is the biggest result in that circle, ahead of Cain's **55-38** win over Tomball and the **40-24** loss to Collins. Three district games tonight, Klein at Klein Collins, Klein Oak at Magnolia West and Tomball Memorial at Tomball, will start settling who takes the last two playoff spots.

Klein Forest comes in off its bye week on a **five-game losing streak**. Its last outing was a **48-20** loss at Magnolia on October 23, and its lone win was a **43-42** shootout over Magnolia West on September 17. Running back **DeJuane Etheridge** is the offense either way: he ran for **200 yards and three touchdowns** in the win over Magnolia West and scored all three Forest touchdowns against Magnolia. The Golden Eagles have given up **407 points in nine games**, but a team playing its finale at home with nothing to lose is never a formality.

Cain averages **36.1 points a game** and has played its best football in bursts this season. Neither team appeared in the **October 26** Class 6A state poll from Dave Campbell's Texas Football. For Cain's seniors, Friday is the last game of their high school careers, and a win still sends them out the right way: **6-4**, a winning season, and a victory in the finale. *One more Friday night. Finish it right.*
